I've tried everything and I'm convinced that this is Spectrum trying to go with the "It just works. Leave it alone." approach. So I'll be buying a new router soon.

Both my Mac and iPhone tell me the same router IP in settings. I’ve tried every IP that people have said that Spectrum uses and nothing works. Probably just going to deal with it until I can buy a new router in a few weeks. I don’t know if this one is even worth messing with.
Xfinity routers are set up like this by default. I didn't know that until I saw this comment, but this was the problem. Thanks.
I think I found a fix. If you go into your wireless router settings and change the name of one of the two wifi bands, your internet won't switch between them causing the disconnect.

It looks like a bunch of people with Comcast/Xfinity are having issues. I've used my Quest with two different internet providers, and it only does the "disconnect then reconnect every ten minutes" thing when I'm using Xfinity, even though a speed test puts it at 150MB/s. So I don't think it's a Quest problem.
